title: Human ENCODE LR-RNA-seq protocol
author: Reese, Fairlie
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Prepare transcript files for analysis
steps.instruction: cerberus.gtf - Superset of detected transcripts GTF cerberus_filtered_abundance.tsv - Detected transcripts; filtered for ISMs w/ no 5'/3' end support flair_filter_transcripts_no_novel_genes.gtf - GTEX GTF with novel genes filtered out transcript_novelties.tsv - metadata about each detected transcript cerberus_psi.tsv - psi values for tss, tes, and ic for each detected transcript cerb_ids.tsv - Cerberus IDs for transcripts in GTEX lr_human_library_data_summary.tsv - Library metadata for the ENCODE LR data lapa_corrected.gtf - Superset of detected transcripts output from LAPA

substeps.instruction: Use transcript_novelties.tsv for metadata about detected transcripts
Use cerberus_psi.tsv for psi values for tss, tes, and ic
Use cerb_ids.tsv for Cerberus IDs in GTEX
Use lr_human_library_data_summary.tsv for ENCODE LR library metadata
Use lapa_corrected.gtf for detected transcripts output from LAPA
